title.narrative: Technical Assistance for Revenue Administration and Revenue Policy - Sri Lanka

description.narrative: Project was expected to center around audit, debt management, and tax payer services based on finding from a July 2018 assessment and a March 2019 TDY. Audit, collections, and taxpayer services advisors conducted meetings with the Internal Revenue Department (IRD) in August 2019. After further consultation with the IRD and the International Monetary Fund, OTA-Revenue determined not to proceed with its engagement.
